text.description_html:
Acorn AL5BR, Smooth Black Iron Arrowhead Latch

The early american Smooth Black Iron Arrowhead Cabinet Latch from Acorn Iron Hardware is for flush doors where the door is flush with its frame. It is packaged as a set: latch with plate, strike plate and mounting screws. The Acorn made Arrowhead Latch is perfect for securing any lightweight door, be it a cabinet, armoire, or window shutter. The smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling.

Specifications for the Acorn Smooth Black Iron Arrowhead Cabinet Latch:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Length: 2-13/16"
  • Height: 1-13/16"
  • Set Includes: latch, latch plate, strike plate, and mounting screws.

Sold Individually
